paragraphs: Welcome to Busarialao College. Since 2005, we have believed that every child can think like a scientist: ask good questions, test ideas and learn from mistakes. Our laboratories, small classes and caring staff give students room to grow in knowledge and in character.

From JSS1 to SS3, we prepare students for BECE, WASSCE and NECO, and for the choices that follow. As we mark our 20th anniversary, we remain committed to discipline, integrity and excellence, and to partnering with parents at every step.
Whether your child joins us as a day student or a boarder, they will find a community that expects their best and supports them to give it. We would be glad to welcome you on a visit.

vision: To be a leading centre of academic excellence where young minds are inspired, empowered, and equipped with the knowledge, skills, and character needed to thrive in a rapidly changing world. [DRAFT]
mission: To provide a conducive learning environment that promotes quality education and intellectual curiosity.
To nurture students through a balanced blend of strong scientific education, moral guidance, and life-building skills.
To develop critical thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators who can compete globally and contribute meaningfully to national development.
To partner with parents, educators, and the community to shape responsible, confident, and well-rounded individuals.
story: We began in 2003 as Top Tutors, a tutorial centre in a two-room apartment at Adewole Estate, Ilorin, where specialist science teachers prepared students for external exams. [DRAFT]
In 2005 Top Tutors became Busarialao College, named in honour of the founder's father, Late Alhaji Busarialao. We moved to Irewolede, Ilorin, and opened with 12 pioneer students and 12 staff. [DRAFT]

Our founder, Alhaji Yunus Gafar, an accountant by profession, saw bright students losing interest in science because schools lacked laboratories, practical exposure and motivated teachers. He set out to build a school where science comes alive. [DRAFT]
Top Tutors remains the college’s academic arm. It sets exam questions, runs teacher training and organises seminars for Local Government and State Ministry staff. [DRAFT]
